title: UR5e · KPIs per controller rung (sim, the producer's numbers)
source: pidtuna-website site/public/data (last changed at c02e786), read 2026-10-26: ur5e.json rungs.*.score and ladder. Sim against illustrative parameters: basis derived, note sim; never measured.

situation.note: The controller rung, as the replay names it.

stop_p90.note: Worst joint's stop error, p90 over holds: the producer's score on this replay (ur5e.json rungs.<rung>.<joint>.score: the coordinated workload, every joint on its own held-out tape at once). Picked, never recomputed.

stop_p90_joint.note: Which joint is worst on stop_p90.

tracking_rms.note: Worst joint's RMS tracking error: the producer's score on this replay (ur5e.json rungs.<rung>.<joint>.score: the coordinated workload, every joint on its own held-out tape at once).

tracking_rms_joint.note: Which joint is worst on tracking_rms.

max_error.note: Worst joint's peak absolute error: the producer's score on this replay (ur5e.json rungs.<rung>.<joint>.score: the coordinated workload, every joint on its own held-out tape at once).

max_error_joint.note: Which joint has the largest peak error.

saturation.note: Worst joint's fraction of rows at ≥ 98 % of the torque cap, 0-1: the producer's score on this replay (ur5e.json rungs.<rung>.<joint>.score: the coordinated workload, every joint on its own held-out tape at once).

admissible.note: Every joint passes the gates: ladder.joints.<joint>.rungs.<rung>: the oracle study's gates on its own workload (the oracle study's shared held-out workload (seed 2, 2 repeats) on the true plant), not this replay.

gates.note: pass, or the union of the joints' refused_for reasons: ladder.joints.<joint>.rungs.<rung>: the oracle study's gates on its own workload (the oracle study's shared held-out workload (seed 2, 2 repeats) on the true plant), not this replay.

vs_factory.note: Factory's worst-joint tracking RMS ÷ this rung's (same replay): times better than shipped gains. Derived from two producer numbers.

feedforward.note: Feed-forward terms the rung used, as the file words them (shoulder_pan_joint's; the arm's joints share it).
